name: Undertaker Mordo
summary: Undertaker Mordo is the caretaker of the crypt of Deathknell, serving as the very first face newly awakened Forsaken see when they open their eyes. He tells those who wake that they are the Lich King's slaves no more and sends them on toward the Forsaken cause; the bodies that never stir go to the fire.

sections.title: The Awakening at Deathknell
sections.body: Keeping the crypt of Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades, Undertaker Mordo watches over the dead as corpses break free from the Scourge's shattered grip. For every newly liberated Forsaken who wakes in the cold of the crypt, Mordo provides their initial bearing in an unrecognizable second life. He assesses their sanity, introduces them to the reality of their condition, and immediately directs them toward duty under Queen Sylvanas Windrunner.

sections.title: Those Who Do Not Wake
sections.body: Not every body brought to the crypt wakes. Mordo does not wait long: the corpses that stay still are tossed into the fire, and those who do stir are greeted with dry impatience and little ceremony. Anyone who rises with their wits intact is sent up the steps and down the road to Shadow Priest Sarvis in the chapel, who explains their new existence. The mindless zombies that overrun the north of the village are Sarvis's concern, not Mordo's; the shadow priest sends the newly risen out to destroy them.

faq.answer: Undertaker Mordo is the Forsaken caretaker of the crypt of Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. He greets freshly risen undead as they wake and directs them into service.

faq.q: Why is he standing in a graveyard?
aliases: why is mordo at the graves
faq.answer: Mordo is the caretaker of Deathknell's crypt, where newly freed undead wake after breaking free from the Lich King's control. He keeps watch there to greet them the moment they stir.

faq.q: What happens to the undead who lose their minds upon waking?
faq.answer: Bodies that never wake are tossed into the fire. The mindless zombies that shamble through the north of Deathknell are not Mordo's charge: Shadow Priest Sarvis sends the newly risen out to destroy them, former brothers and sisters or not.

faq.q: Where does Mordo send newly risen Forsaken?
aliases: where do i go after mordo
faq.answer: After ensuring a newly awakened soul has their wits about them, Mordo sends them out of the crypt and down the road to the chapel to speak with Shadow Priest Sarvis, who explains what it means to join the ranks of the Forsaken.

angles.text: Undertaker Mordo is the very first person you speak with upon opening your eyes in death, guiding your first tentative steps in service to Queen Sylvanas.
